test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

More than 40 percent of the world’s population lives in regions where water has becoming increasingly scarce.

options.text: More than 40 percent of the world’s population

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence contains an **error in option 1**: "has becoming increasingly scarce".
 
• The** problem lies** in the **verb tense.**
 
• **In English,** the **present perfect tense** is** formed by** using "has" or "have" followed by a past participle (in most cases, a verb ending in -ed).
 
• The verb **"become" **should be used in its past participle form, "become", not "becoming".
 
• The phrase should be corrected to** "has become increasingly scarce".**

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* "More than 40 percent of the world’s population lives in regions where water has become increasingly scarce."*
